preconditions.expression: isinstance(grid, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in grid) and all(isinstance(cost, int) and 1 <= cost <= 1000 for row in grid for cost in row)
preconditions.description: grid is a list of lists of integers, each integer representing the cost to traverse through that cell, with 1 <= cost <= 1000, and the grid is square with size n x n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(grid) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row in the grid has the same length as the number of rows in the grid, ensuring the grid is square.
The grid size is between 1 and 500, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum cost to reach the bottom right cell from the top left cell.
